endpoints.summary: Create a new authorization (OTP or biometrics)
endpoints.description: Creates a new authorization by capturing patient consent via OTP or biometrics. Use the OTP strategy for standard outpatient and inpatient consent; use the biometrics strategy (eKYC or fingerprint) when the facility has a registered hardware agent. The same endpoint is used across claims creation and consent workflows.

requestBody.description: Authorization request payload. Choose one strategy: OTP (phone-based one-time password) or Biometrics (eKYC/fingerprint via hardware agent).

properties.name: patient_id
properties.description: The patient's Client Registry identifier.

properties.name: service_type
properties.description: Type of service being authorized.

properties.name: otp
properties.description: One-time password delivered to the patient's registered phone number.

properties.name: interventions
properties.description: List of intervention codes for the services being requested in this visit.
